name: Bargas (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly, yellow above and crimson below, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Bargas (a tower above waves on red).
history: The heraldic arms were approved by royal decree of 30 March 1978 and published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado of 25 April 1978. The flag was officially approved on 9 September 2008 and published in the Diario Oficial de Castilla-La Mancha of 25 September 2008: rectangular, of proportions 2:3, divided diagonally from the top of the hoist to the bottom of the fly, yellow the upper part and crimson the lower, bearing at the centre the crowned arms of the municipality.
